note: Earth suit of the four-crew framework. Cast is reserved away from all 22 Major Arcana species.

suit.name: Pentacles
suit.domain: money, craft, work, home, the material world
suit.coreRule: All subjects anatomically bird; streetwear fitted to bird anatomy; no humanoid forms; no gore.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.description: A bowerbird presents a single gleaming coin-berry at a garden gate.
cards.pose: Perched at an arched garden gate, one wingtip extended offering a bright coin-berry, body turned toward the viewer.
cards.varietyNotes: Suit anchor species. Glossy blue-black bowerbird + offered coin reads 'opportunity' at a glance.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Opens money/resource generation; a seed card that funds later Pentacles plays.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.description: A starling balances two coins on its wingtips along a wire.
cards.pose: Walking a taut wire mid-balance, wings spread wide, a coin teetering on each wingtip, tail flicking.
cards.varietyNotes: Iridescent speckled starling on a wire; spread-wing balance separates it from the perched bowerbird pips.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Resource shuffle; move or rebalance two resources between lanes each turn.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.description: Three weavers build a nest-arch together from a shared blueprint.
cards.pose: Three weavers at a half-built straw arch, two threading stalks while one reads a pinned blueprint.
cards.varietyNotes: Three small buff weavers around a communal arch; collaborative build distinguishes them from solo pips.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Build mechanic; multiple workers complete a structure faster for a shared bonus.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.description: A pigeon clutches four coins tightly, wings curled protectively inward.
cards.pose: Hunched on a ledge, wings wrapped around a stack of four coins, one underfoot, gaze guarded and wary.
cards.varietyNotes: City pigeon's gray bulk + closed, hoarding curl contrasts the open offering of the Ace.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Lock/hold effect; freeze your resources to protect them but skip spending.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.description: Two ragged birds huddle outside a warm lit market window.
cards.pose: Two bedraggled pigeons in cold alley shadow, looking up at a golden window they cannot enter, feathers fluffed against chill.
cards.varietyNotes: Two huddled pigeons against a lit window; the warm glow stays out of reach, keeping the lack in frame.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Cost/setback card; pay a hardship now to unlock aid or recovery later.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.description: A starling shares seed with two smaller birds as the scales hang level.
cards.pose: Perched at a balanced market scale, scattering seed from a pouch to two upturned smaller birds below.
cards.varietyNotes: Same starling as the Two, now generous and grounded; the level scale signals fairness.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Distribute effect; share resources to allies with a balancing payoff.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.description: A bowerbird leans on a tool, eyeing a vine heavy with ripening coin-fruit.
cards.pose: Leaning thoughtfully on a hoe beside a trellis, head tilted up at a vine of slowly ripening coin-fruit, in no hurry.
cards.varietyNotes: Bowerbird at rest beside a growing vine; the leaning, waiting pose reads investment, not action.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Slow-burn investment; a resource that ripens into a bigger payout if left to grow.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.description: A weaver crafts coin after coin at a workbench.
cards.pose: Bent in focus over a cluttered workbench, hammering a fresh coin while finished coins hang in a neat row.
cards.varietyNotes: Solo weaver hard at the bench contrasts the three-weaver teamwork of the Three; rows of coins show output.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Craft loop; repeat a small action each turn to steadily produce resources.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.description: A poised bowerbird stands alone in a lush treasure-garden.
cards.pose: Settled and elegant amid a curated bower of coins, berries, and blue trinkets, one wing resting on a coin-laden branch.
cards.varietyNotes: Bowerbird's real treasure-hoarding instinct made literal; gold accent marks the suit's prosperity high point.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Solo payoff; cash in accumulated wealth for a strong self-sufficient reward.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.description: A multigenerational flock gathers at the market arch with ten coins and banners flying.
cards.pose: An elder, adults, and fledglings clustered beneath a grand coin-crowned market arch, ten coins strung as banners overhead.
cards.varietyNotes: Multi-generation weaver flock under the arch is the material summit; market-gold lifts it above the earth tones.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Capstone economy; rewards a full built-up board of Pentacles assets with lasting value.

cards.name: Fledgling of Pentacles
cards.description: The youngest apprentice of Groundwork, a hoopoe studying a single coin with care.
cards.pose: Bright-eyed and curious, crest half-raised, turning a coin over in its bill to examine it at the market's edge.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Fledgling = youngest apprentice; the hoopoe's barred wings and crest give a distinct silhouette.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Cheap study unit; scouts or banks a single resource to learn a build option.

cards.name: Outrider of Pentacles
cards.description: The mobile worker of Groundwork, a pigeon coursing the market routes with a coin-laden satchel.
cards.pose: In strong purposeful flight low over the rooftops, a heavy coin-satchel slung across its breast, route map clipped to one leg.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Outrider = always in motion; only dynamic flight pose among the Pentacles courts.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Mobile courier; reliably hauls and delivers resources across the board each turn.

cards.name: Matron of Pentacles
cards.description: The inner master of Groundwork, a poised bowerbird enthroned among her finest treasures.
cards.pose: Seated and serene on a moss-cushioned coin-throne, a chosen coin cradled close, surrounded by a curated bower.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Matron = poised inner mastery of craft and treasure; her tended bower distinguishes her from the Elder.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Economy leader; grows and protects the crew's resource pool over time.

cards.name: Elder of Pentacles
cards.description: The crew boss of Groundwork, a weaver elder ruling atop the great communal nest at market morning.
cards.pose: Standing tall and still atop a vast communal nest-citadel, wings folded, surveying the market he built below.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Elder = monumental builder authority; the weaver atop his own great nest is the suit's flagship at full command.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Faction leader; build and provide effects that grow and rally the whole Pentacles crew.
